caption_L1: Here a is a bar diagram called Net number of interprovincial migrants in Saskatchewan from 2001 to 2020. The x-axis shows Year using categorical scale starting with 2000-2001 and ending with 2019-2020* while the y-axis measures Number of migrants using categorical scale from −10,000 to 5,000.
caption_L2L3: In a the twenty year period, 2000 - 2020, the NET number of interprovincial migrants fell dramatically. They did rise in the period 2007-2013, but not by enough to counteract the overall fall within the time period.
